items.ja: ブルズが Buddy Hield を獲得(ホーネッツから。見返り:Rob Dillingham)
items.en: Acquired G Buddy Hield from Charlotte in exchange for G Rob Dillingham.

items.ja: ホーネッツが Rob Dillingham を獲得(ブルズから。見返り:Buddy Hield)
items.en: Acquired G Rob Dillingham from Chicago Bulls for G Buddy Hield.

items.ja: ホーネッツが Buddy Hield・Ryan Nembhard・金銭 を獲得(ホークスから。見返り:Dorian Finney-Smith)
items.en: Waived G DJ Armstrong and C Tre Carroll. Acquired Gs Buddy Hield, Ryan Nembhard and cash considerations from Atlanta in exchange for F Dorian Finney-Smith.

items.ja: ペリカンズが AJ Johnson・Taj Gibson を獲得(グリズリーズから。見返り:Micah Peavy・Jordan Hawkins・ドラフト指名権など)
items.en: Acquired G AJ Johnson and F Taj Gibson from Memphis in exchange for G Micah Peavy, G Jordan Hawkins and draft considerations.

items.ja: グリズリーズが Micah Peavy・Jordan Hawkins・ドラフト指名権など を獲得(ペリカンズから。見返り:AJ Johnson・Taj Gibson)
items.en: Acquired G Micah Peavy, G Jordan Hawkins and draft considerations from New Orleans Pelicans for G AJ Johnson and F Taj Gibson.
